scope: New mission-directed workbench acceptance; developer-authored, not independent
requirements: Original controlled loop and Hound untouched
Search->repository metadata->commit->tree->file->existing Hound->evidence through real code
Public repository confirmation before reading content
GET only; fixed GitHub API endpoint families; reject redirects
Persist queue, source identities, global cooldown and bounded retry attempts
Reject late or wrong claim tokens; idempotent delivery
Both Git blob and content SHA256 verified; no source code retention in ledger/report
License declaration not reuse approval; conflicts and missing licenses remain explicit
Truncated searches and trees never count as full repository coverage
Provider and source byte budgets enforced on success and failures
Empty result is no candidate, not successful improvement
Tampered profile/engine blocks continuation
Loopback authenticated UI; reject hostile Host and Origin requests
Report includes failures and unknowns with release approval false
All new tests and inherited suites executed
Clean extraction replay and original preservation verified
Freeze source-bound reuse requirements; no API observation becomes a behavior guarantee
Detect stale source, evidence-head truncation and conflicting writer revisions
Run first-party JSON reuse task through actual Hound and fixed behavior checks
CLI and HTTP deliver same comparison and portable source-locked packet
No user-supplied executable test or arbitrary code runner
Do not import or execute collected code; no write to original input containers
Recognize Python files and whole Python text with positive syntax evidence
Find explicit Python fences in text/Markdown and retain original member line ranges
Do not interpret prose, shell instructions, old test claims or requirements lists as executed code
Inspect nested ZIP members in memory under shared size, entry, ratio and depth limits
Reject traversal, duplicate ambiguous member names, links, encryption and unsafe output paths
List unsupported formats, syntax errors and budget omissions rather than implying absence
Index all recognized definitions even when existing exact-API profiles yield no findings
Keep content equivalence separate from origin identity; preserve every source occurrence
Build repeatable source-hash-bound checkpoints and verify source bytes before cache reuse
Search by names, declared docs and observed imports without quality or correctness scores
Render selected results safely in the existing Workbench; no model, deployment or source-store mutations
Keep private development corpora private; never label used examples independent holdout
Generate hypotheses from unmet workflow information requirements, not product-name recombinations
Keep not-described, explicitly-missing, manual, supported and contradictory evidence distinct
Exact evidence quotes must match source text and offsets; bind all input versions
A snippet demonstrates what the source says, not semantic truth or market demand
Deduplicate repeated text, source families and declared derivative sources before counting corroboration
Never treat code, advertisements or synthetic fixtures as independent user-demand observations
Discard stale evidence from support while retaining it for review; future dates rejected
Do not turn a related-domain existing product into proof that a target workflow is solved
Purpose and mechanism are separate; assumptions and prerequisites accompany analogies
Link generated code investigations through existing corpus search with actual source identities
Code retrieval never promotes technical readiness, demand, novelty or rights
Emit both a concrete concept and a disconfirmation/experiment plan
Keep rejected ideas and feedback without changing truth gates
No network, execution, installation or deployment is authorized by document text
CLI and authenticated local HTTP use the same evaluation implementation
Persist immutable runs, return repeat results idempotently, detect changed bytes
Input/file/output bounds, private-public separation and source sampling limitations remain visible
Retain all baseline tests; evaluate useful and misleading opportunities, refine actual failures
Report rule-based and reviewer-supplied reasoning, not autonomous models
No approval state may claim a validated business or production-ready generated application
